meta_description: The governed data estate every intelligence program silently depends on.

blocks.x: The governed data estate every intelligence program silently depends on.

Achala Forge operationalizes the lakehouse: medallion pipelines with data contracts, Unity Catalog-class governance, lineage and freshness SLAs, streaming and batch in one estate, and the AI-ready layer (feature stores, vector search, retrieval services) built on the same governed data. It is the substrate tower made product.

Forge is deliberately boring where it matters: schema contracts enforced at boundaries, expectations tested on every pipeline, cost telemetry per workload, and audit exports regulators can read. Teams inherit reliability as a measured property — and GenAI programs inherit a corpus that doesn't rot.

items: feature store, vector search, retrieval services
owned, SLA'd products with consumer contracts

blocks.x: Forge inherits platform controls from the customer landing zone and adds its own: contract enforcement, lineage capture, quality gates and privacy-tag-driven access. Every dataset carries its owner, SLA and classification — governance is system behavior, not committee minutes.

items: every artifact the platform produces doubles as audit evidence — no reconstruction projects.
teams start at pattern 80% and spend their budget on the 20% that is genuinely yours.
named control owner per deployment; platform telemetry makes the owner's job inspectable.

blocks.x: Most programs deploy Achala Forge inside the customer's landing zone with a Achala pod operating it through a named run model, then transfer operations to client teams once the SLOs have held for two quarters.
Certified integration surface: Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka, dbt, Unity Catalog/Purview.
Primary industry deployments: Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Retail & Consumer Goods, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Energy & Utilities, Manufacturing & Industrial.
